conviction_note: The H1 number itself is about in line. The 月次 put Q2 sales about 1% under the implied plan, so OP looks roughly 1% light. What tilts this up is how the stock has reacted when results come with a buyback. Every H1 and FY release since Oct 2024 has carried a ¥500m buyback, and the next-open reactions at H1/FY prints were +3.1/-0.1/+4.9/+7.2/+4.7. Q1/Q3 prints carry no buyback and averaged -2.5 (5 of 6 down). A September SSS of +12.4% also supports holding the FY guide, and the stock has already given back the bump from that release. I emit +1.4 against a findings sum of +1.6, taking 0.2 off because the capital-return pattern rests on five prints.

findings.finding: Nishimatsuya has announced a ¥500m (~0.4-0.5%) open-market buyback with every H1 and FY release since Oct 2024 (2024-10-02, 2025-04, 2025-10-01, 2026-04-02), so one is very likely again on 2026-10-01. The stock's next-open reaction at H1/FY releases has been +3.11/-0.08/+4.88/+7.23/+4.74 (mean +4.0), against a mean of -2.5 at Q1/Q3 releases that carry no capital-return decision.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Close-to-next-open moves from Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/7545.T?range=3y&interval=1d): 2025-10-01 H1 opened +7.23% even though H1 OP missed plan (7,305 vs 7,500). Kabutan put the move down to the dividend raise (15→16) and the buyback. 2026-04-02 FY +4.74, 2025-04-02 FY +4.88, 2024-10-02 H1 -0.08 (buyback alone). Q1/Q3: -4.01, -1.61, -2.66, -6.73, +0.42, -0.34.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market expected the usual H1 capital-return package, the H1/FY prints would not keep opening +4-7%. Pre-print there is nothing building for it: the stock is -2.99% over 20 days and -0.15% over 5, short and margin positioning is flat, and the repeat-buyback pattern appears in no wire preview. Coverage is one mid-tier neutral (TP 2,020).

findings.finding: The 月次 put Q2 (May 21-Aug 20) all-store sales at +4.5% YoY (June 104.9, July 103.0, August 105.9), against the +5.7% the H1 plan implies (102,934 - Q1 54,554 = 48,380 vs LY Q2 45,759). That leaves H1 sales about 0.5% short, and with Q2 OP flat at about 2,100 for two years, H1 OP lands near 7,300-7,450 against the 7,460 plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last H1 (2025-10-01) missed plan OP by 2.6% (7,305 vs 7,500) and sales by 2.2%, and the stock opened +7.23% on capital return. Holders have looked through small H1 misses.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Every monthly figure is public and the slip is small. The one part not visible is gross margin: July's cool first half hurt summer clothing (SSS 99.1), which raises the risk of Q2 clearance markdowns. The market would see this only in the tanshin.
findings.independence: Q1 tanshin for the plan arithmetic: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260626/140120260623576707.pdf. July monthly commentary: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260721/140120260721596728.pdf. Kabutan finance page for LY Q2: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7545

findings.finding: September (Aug 21-Sep 20, the first month of Q3) ran SSS +12.4% and all-store +15.2%, with average ticket +3.3% on full-price autumn clothing. That is the best month of the year and supports keeping the FY OP guide of 12,540, which needs H2 OP of 5,080 against 2,636 last year. The stock has fully given back the +1.4% reaction to that release (1,952 → 1,979 → 1,949).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year the FY guide was held at H1 (2025-10-01, open +7.23) and cut on 2025-12-29 (open -0.58), after the Q3 print had already opened -6.73. FY guide releases in April opened +4.88 and +4.74.
findings.why_not_priced: The price shows doubt about the guide. It sits at 13.9x guided EPS of 140, and consensus ordinary (12,500) is still 4% below the company's 13,000, unchanged over the 4 weeks that include the September print. If the market had credited September, the stock would have held above 1,979 and consensus would have moved toward the guide.
